name: METFORMIN / SITAGLIPTINE 850/50MG 28 TABLETS MERCK
description: This combination of Metformin (850 mg) and Sitagliptin (50 mg) is a medication primarily indicated to improve blood sugar control in adult patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus. It serves the following specific purposes: Glycemic control: It is used in conjunction with diet and exercise when blood sugar is not adequately controlled with metformin alone or when the patient is already taking both medications separately. Dual mechanism of action: Metformin: Reduces glucose production in the liver and improves glucose sensitivity. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
